sources.title: GitHub - princeton-nlp/SimCSE: [EMNLP 2021] SimCSE: Simple Contrastive ...
sources.snippet: Unsupervised SimCSE simply takes an input sentence and predicts itself in a contrastive learning framework, with only standard dropout used as noise. Our supervised SimCSE incorporates annotated pairs from NLI datasets into contrastive learning by using entailment pairs as positives and contradiction pairs as hard negatives.
